sourceDisposition.meaning: No inspected evidence establishes v2 clearance; this is not proof that captures do not exist. Legacy code and audit identify candidate mappings, not admitted datasets.
sourceDisposition.rights: No provider intended-use rights approval verified. Endpoint accessibility, private research contract and source enums do not transfer v2 permission.
sourceDisposition.custody: Signed exposure/allocation register absent. Keep whole-game revisions together, preserve actual first receipt/publication/correction clocks and all past actors/purposes/trials. 2024–25 excluded; 2025–26 reserved; 2022–24 not automatically cleared. Later captures remain retrospective reconstructions.

firstRehearsal.purpose: One offline ingestion, official-appearance semantics and as-of replay smoke, before any model accuracy work. No fitting, candidate selection, calibration, predictive scoring or scientific qualification.
firstRehearsal.stageOne: Metadata-only intake, rights/custodian verification and exact file hash allowlist. No payload opening on metadata arrival alone.
firstRehearsal.stageTwo: Only after scoped local row-read permission and reviewed adapter: admit one ordinary appearance case with its schedule/affiliation/receipt evidence, preserve missingness, replay two fixed cutoffs surrounding first receipt to demonstrate unavailable-before/available-after. Do not infer historical publication from reconstruction.
firstRehearsal.followOn: Up to one approved case each for credited zero-minute/penalty-only, dressed-unused, verified nonappearance, ambiguous/incomplete feed and game not played, in the same finite packet. Ordinary case alone cannot close official-appearance semantic validation.
acceptance: Exact byte hash and parsed hash distinguished; identity/units and original clocks retained.
Unavailable/missing remains unavailable, never zero. PIM is penalty minutes; credited zero-minute case must not be discarded by positive-TOI legacy logic.
Incomplete feed cannot establish nonappearance. Opportunity denominator is independent of successful forecast rows.
Retain all cases, refusals, timings and reconstruction classification; no serving or qualification flag changes.

minimalArtifactRequest.now: Return metadata only for ONE existing, expressly nonprotected ordinary-appearance packet; if absent, say absent without acquiring it. Identify source owner/custodian and permission for isolated local v2 semantic/replay use.
required: Exact dataset/capture IDs, canonical player/game/team IDs, UTC period and intended purpose; no guessed identities.
Original-byte SHA-256 and manifest SHA-256, byte/row/game counts, local paths, media/schema versions; enumerate all files including schedule/affiliation dependencies.
Rights evidence reference and authorized owner attestation covering this use; signed custody/exposure register with all actors, access dates, purposes, trials, allocation and whole-game grouping.
Publication if known, first receipt, effective time, correction chain and finality/completeness evidence references.
Exact schema paths, units and official credit rule for seven categories and TOI; schedule/start and affiliation mapping. Missing fields explicitly unavailable.
Explicit permission for later payload inspection and proposed local caps; no protected numerical labels in metadata.
minimalArtifactRequest.laterOptionalCases: Request metadata identifying at most one existing nonprotected packet for each of the five edge dispositions; original bytes only after clearance. Do not fabricate an official rare case or synthesize it as real.

sourceMappings.G_A_SOG_HIT_BLK_PIM: baselineSourceLineage.ts maps goals/assists/sog or shots/hits/blockedShots/pim; pim is minutes. Actual provider version/path/credit semantics require owner proof.
sourceMappings.PPP: nativePowerPlayPoints.ts reconciles final landing scoring and boxscore PP goals/assists; historical observed outcome, not pregame feature.
sourceMappings.appearance: Legacy baselineAppearanceFromBoxscore/nativeParticipationFrame use positive TOI; cannot directly supply v2 official-appearance labels.
sourceMappings.schedule_affiliation: Need accepted revision hashes, canonical team/game IDs, effective versus receipt times, actual-start proof and complete affiliation coverage.
sourceMappings.future_model_features: Draft last20/365day minimum5 history, opponent SOG-against, own total/PP TOI, home and previous team-game actual-end mappings are unvalidated; not needed for first semantic smoke and must not enlarge it.

proposedCaps.basis: Retained synthetic local fixture measured 1.688s elapsed, Node user/system CPU 0.319608/0.033697s, maxRSS 163408 KiB, 3030 history rows / 6895856 serialized bytes. Proposed caps provide bounded headroom for a much smaller parser smoke, not scaling evidence. PostgreSQL child resources were excluded from that measurement.
proposedCaps.enforcement: Implement pre-read byte/allowlist checks, bounded row iteration, output accounting and watchdog/resource instrumentation before run. Stop on first integrity/cap breach; retain failure and do not auto-expand or retry.

infrastructure.availableEvidence: Canonical local checkout, Python metadata validator, TypeScript pure contracts/data/schedule code, fixture harness and retained native local database capacity receipt. Current runtime/service availability not re-probed. No remote infrastructure required.
infrastructure.constraints: Use file-backed isolated local output; do not import operational skater-stage/server orchestration or call ingestion routes. Existing pipeline accepts fixture/reconstruction only; live prospective producer still absent. Concurrency repair/retest belongs to Chef and is not certified by this document.

commandsAfterMetadataArrives.precondition: Metadata only, <=1 MiB, shaped to intake-template.json; replace placeholder with actual approved local metadata path.
commandsAfterMetadataArrives.meaning: Validator opens metadata only, exit2 means issues. Full-program validator may retain unrelated scientific/shadow gaps; do not fabricate fields to make it pass. Success still means review required, not permission.

missingImplementation: Focused file-only real-source parser/adapter with schema and unit mappings, original-byte verification and explicit official-credit labels.
Bounded local CLI for exact allowlisted packet and fixed cutoffs; no existing real-data rehearsal command established in inspected evidence. Do not run legacy replay or provider routes as substitute.
Case-specific expected semantic assertions, immutable receipt/report output, integrity rejection and resource-stop enforcement.
Chef concurrency fix and regression evidence before any storage/queue-backed rehearsal; first file-only parser smoke does not certify those paths.
outstandingDecisions: Named source owner/custodian and authentic rights/custody references.
Exact nonprotected existing packet and local row-read authorization; metadata approval does not authorize acquisition.
Accept exact local caps/output path and pin adapter/code/input hashes before execution.
Independent reviewed development registration and staged mean/calibration chronology required later for fitting; final freeze and untouched approval remain separate.
